good_thing: (Stony Brook, New York): Stony Brook University Libraries has introduced Rubo, a 4-foot-6 library-assistant robot, with a week-long meet-and-greet. Rubo is designed to answer campus and library questions, help with book checkout and study-room reservations, chat in several languages, and play rock-paper-scissors.
current_or_history: On November 19, 1863, Abraham Lincoln gave the Gettysburg Address at the dedication of the Soldiers’ National Cemetery in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania. Edward Everett, the featured orator, spoke for more than two hours; Lincoln spoke for about two minutes, after finishing his 272-word address at attorney David Wills’s home the night before.
tiny_fact: A day on Venus lasts 243 Earth days, while its year lasts 225. It rotates so slowly, and backward relative to most planets, that the Sun would rise in the west there.
thought: A little usefulness, offered kindly, can make a place feel more welcoming.
